overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no evidence the Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting, and whether a Board vote was required under the Town Manager Act is outside its jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting to authorize the ZBA's lawsuit to enforce a subpoena, relying on the Town Manager Act.
allegations.key_passage: we have not found any evidence supporting the inference that the Board deliberated outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Board argued the complaint was untimely because the lawsuit was discussed in open session in June 2017; the AG found the complaint timely and reached the merits.
allegations.key_passage: We do not believe that this was sufficient to put a reasonable member of the public on notice.

allegations.summary: Whether the Town Manager Act required a separate Board vote to authorize litigation was a dispute the AG said was outside its jurisdiction.
allegations.key_passage: This is a dispute over which our office has no jurisdiction.
